name: Acsád (Hungary)
description: A vertical banner of two stripes, blue at the hoist and white at the fly, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Acsád: a blue shield with a white bend, ears of grain and a ploughshare, with a black eagle crest.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
